Commentary.Commentary: Bangladesh will be really pleased with their efforts. They bowled well and fielded extremely well to not let the star-studded Indian batting line-up run away with the show. All their bowlers shared the spoils, but it was Qazi Onik and Nayeem Hasan who were clinical. The pacer took three wickets while the spinner got two. Now then, their batsmen have the task cut out and it won't be easy as they will have to counter a good bowling attack. Will we see Bangla Tigers causing an upset? Or will it be a one-way traffic? Join us in a bit for the run chase...

After losing Shaw, Gill continued to march on and along with Harvik Desai he motored along well, scoring another 74-run stand. However, both the set batsmen got dismissed in quick time and it seemed like Bangladesh will claw their way back. They almost did by picking up wickets at regular intervals but Abhishek Sharma held one end up and displayed a sensational batting show by registering his fifty and taking the score to a respectable one.

A decent batting effort from the Indians on this two-paced surface. They won the toss and decided to have a go with the bat. Manjot Kalra was dismissed early but skipper, Prithvi Shaw and Shubman Gill steadied the ship considerably. They took their time and then started to attack. Both stitched a good 86-run stand for the second wicket before Shaw missed out on his fifty.

OUT! Bowled 'em! Saif Hassan fires it full on middle and leg, Shiva Singh gets a long way across to play the ugly-looking slog. Misses it completely to see the stumps shattered behind. INDIA ARE BOWLED OUT FOR 265!

A huge shout for an LBW! Not given! Fuller on the stumps, Shiva Singh gets down the play the reverse sweep but misses to get pinged on the pads. A loud appeal follows but the umpire pays no heed. That looked plumb!
Full toss, Porel didn't expect this. just pushes it to the cover fielder.
Ishan Porel is the last man in.

OUT! Gloved it! Abhishek Sharma has been given the marching order by the umpire. Slower bumper, takes ages to come to the batsman. Sharma waits for it and then tries to pull but is undone by the slowness on the ball. It goes off the gloves and Islam Ankon takes another catch behind the stumps. A superb knock, nonetheless.
Driven through the covers by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.

Fifty for Abhishek Sharma and it's a gem of an innings from this man! Mahmud follows the batsman and bowls a short ball on leg, Abhishek Sharma taps it in front of the point fielder and gets to the other end.
FOUR! Finesse! Mahmud tries to bowl another yorker but this time he serves a low full toss. Sharma with a high back-lift just lofts it down the ground. It whistles away to the fence. AS on 49 now!
Yorker length on the stumps, SS keeps it out to short mid-wicket for a single.
Wide! Slower one but it's sprayed down the leg side, Singh looks to flick but misses.
Quicker one but a bit too full, Shiva swings hard at it and gets an edge. It hits the keeper's pads and deflects towards short third man for a single.
The batsman has driven it through mid off. The batsmen have run through for a single.
FOUR! Just a lift! Nicely tossed up on off, Abhishek Sharma comes down the track and lifts it inside out over extra cover for a boundary. He's playing a superb innings here.
Shiva Singh is the new man in.
OUT! Gone! Hassan floats it up outside off, Shivam Mavi gets underneath it and tries to heave it across the line. He does so but finds Aminul Islam at long on who takes a sitter.
Tossed up delivery on the stumps, worked away towards mid-wicket. Mavi wants another but is sent back. The throw comes in at the bowler's end and it hits the timber but Sharma was well in.

FOUR! Powerfully struck! 250 comes up for India! Saif darts it in on leg, Sharma dances down the track and smacks it straight down the ground. The man from long on comes across to his right to stop it but the ball still wins the race.

Robiul Hoque is back into the attack. What happened there? He comes steaming in and just when he was about to deliver, Hoque pulls out. Not sure what the issue is and he is now seen limping off the field. Saif Hassan now comes on to bowl.
FOUR! Flayed it away! Mavi backs away to a fuller ball outside off and carves it over backward point for a boundary to end the over.
Brilliant bowling! Hasan arrows in another yorker, Abhishek Sharma comes down the track and digs it out in front of square on the off side for a single.
Mahmud with another yorker, this time outside off, Shivam could only jam it out towards sweeper cover for a single.
Beaten! Back of a length delivery outside off, Mavi stays leg side to crack this one but gets beaten all ends up.
Yorker on middle and off, AS jams it out towards cover for a single.
Shivam Mavi is the new man in.

OUT! Bull's eye from Qazi Onik! The fielding from Bangladesh has been bang on today. Another one bites the dust. Mahmud fires in a fuller ball on middle and leg, Sharma jams it out towards short mid-wicket. Roy sets off from the other end but seeing Qazi charging towards it, Abhishek sends him back. Onik collects the ball, takes his time and nails the stumps at the bowler's end as Roy dives to get back in. They refer it upstairs and replays find the batsman well short.
Direct hit at the non-striker's end and this looks close. Anukul Roy is the man in question and it seems like even the dive wouldn't save him. Referred upstairs...
Fuller ball outside off, driven towards long off. Looks for two but won't get it.

FOUR! One-bounce and into the rope! Reminds me of Jadeja! He plays this shot exactly in the same manner. Gets a fuller ball, Abhishek Sharma gets under it and heaves it straight back down the ground for a boundary.
Waits for the ball to come to him and then ticks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Angles it away on the shorter length outside off, Sharma slaps it over point for just a single.
Hangs back to a length delivery and runs it down towards third man for a single.
Anukul Roy walks out at no. 8.

OUT! Edged and taken! Qazi with another one! Beautiful bowling from him. Comes around the wicket and hurls another cutter by holding it cross-seam. It pitches and turns away with a little bit of extra bounce. Nagarkoti hops and tries to steer it down towards third man but the ball takes the outside edge and Islam Ankon takes a regulation catch behind the stumps.
Lofts this length ball over extra cover and shall keep the strike.
Wide! Mahmud sees the batsman making room and hence he fires it full and wide outside off. Kamlesh can't reach to it and gets beaten. It's called as a wide and the bowler isn't impressed.
Yorker on the stumps, Nagarkoti jams it down to long on and runs two.
Drives this another fuller delivery through covers and scampers through for a single.
Fullish on middle, worked down to long on for a single.

Really good running! Mahmud rolls his fingers over the ball, drops it short on middle. Sharma waits for it and then pulls it just over the man at mid-wicket. The ball races away in the deep before the fielder mops it up. Three runs taken.
Fuller delivery on the pads, whipped straight to the man at mid-wicket.
Hasan Mahmud to bowl from the other end.
Good ball! Fuller and pacy delivery, angling in on middle and leg, Sharma misses his flick. The ball hits the pads and rolls towards the off side. The batsmen take a leg bye.

FOUR! A waist height no ball from Onik. His skipper is really fuming. Doles out a full toss, Sharma swivels and helps it with a pull over backward square leg for a boundary. What's more? Free Hit coming up.
Ahead of a length outside off, tapped in front of point for a single.
Stays behind the line and with an angled bat, Kamlesh pokes it to the point fielder.
Kamlesh Nagarkoti walk out to bat next.

OUT! Qazi Onik comes and strikes! He is really effective with his cutters. Bowls another one, it grips off the surface a touch. Parag stays back to pull but isn't in any control of the shot. Gets it off the high portion of the bat towards mid-wicket where Saif Hassan comes charging in and dives forward to snatch it inches above the ground. Excellent take from the Bangladesh skipper.
Back of a length delivery on middle, defended off the back foot.
Starts the new spell with a fuller ball from over the wicket, Sharma eases it down to long on for just a single.
Qazi Onik is back on. He was excellent with the new ball, can he do some magic with the soft ball? Well, his side would hope for him to deliver.
Flatter one outside off, slapped straight towards the extra cover fielder. 12 off the over, a huge one for the Indians.

SIX! Smoked it! Afif is taken for aplenty. Certainly this won't please his skipper. He gives it a nice loop, Parag dances down the track, meets the pitch of the ball and hammers the slog over the deep mid-wicket fence for a maximum all the way.
Driven through mid on by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Wide! Fires it down the leg side, Sharma misses his clip but it's a good take by the keeper behind who has been really good today.
FOUR! Superb hit! Abhishek Sharma skips down the track and belts it over extra cover to pick up a much-needed boundary for his side.
Slower through the air, around off, Sharma looks to defend but gets an inside edge on the pads.
Flighted ball around middle and leg, defended back to the bowler.
Afif Hossain is brought back into the attack. He has got three overs. Bangladesh want to get through the overs quickly and hence they bring back another spinner...
No, he can't! Single to finish! A full ball on middle, driven down to long on for a run. He ends his spell with brilliant figures of 10-0-36-2. He has brought Bangladesh back in the game here.
Five! Fires it on middle, Sharma works it to short fine leg. Can he bowl a maiden here?
Make that four! Gives it air on off, driven back to the bowler.
Gives it air on off, turning away. Abhishek defends it. 3 dots!
Tosses it up on off, Sharma pushes it towards point.
Flatter on the stumps, the batsman defends it off the back foot.
Darted on leg, clipped on the bounce to the mid-wicket fielder. A dot to end the 41st over.
Full and fired into the blockhole, jammed out through cover for a single.
Full toss on off, Parag mistimes his punch towards long off to bring up the 200 for India.
Loopy ball outside off, driven down to long off for one.
Stays behind the line to this floated ball and keeps it out.

Sharma comes down the track and drags this tossed up ball from outside off towards long on. It goes on the bounce to the fielder there who charges towards the ball but then takes his eyes off it. Fumbles and they take another.
Powerplay 3 time. Now a maximum of five fielders can be placed outside the circle. How many can India get in the last 10 overs? Remains to be seen...
Flattish ball on the stumps, flicked towards deep mid-wicket and they scamper through for a couple.
Eases one down to long on and gets to the other end.
Leans forward and across and works it against the turn towards mid on.
Loopy delivery outside off, defended into the ground.
Rocks back to this short ball and punches it down to long on for a single.

This one is landed around off, it spins back in, Sharma gets across to flick but misses to get hit on the pads. Nayeem keeps appealing but the umpire turns it down. Maybe, the angle was taking it down leg.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. They pick up a single.
Very full and fired on off, Sharma jams it out on the bounce back to the bowler who despite a leap fails to stop it. It goes down to long off and they take one.
Saif bowls a half-tracker outside off, Abhishek Sharma sits deep in the crease and slaps it through point to collect a couple of runs.
On middle and leg, wristed towards mid-wicket for nothing.
Slower and shorter outside off, Sharma pokes it towards the point fielder.
Slows it through the air outside off, Sharma comes down the track to cut but is undone in the flight. Just keeps it out on the off side.
Leans nicely into the tossed up ball and drives it through cover for a single.
Outside off, Abhishek prods forward in defense.
Length delivery, a bit of air on this one. Nudged towards square leg for a single.
Played to mid-wicket region by the batsman.
Flatter one on off, punched down to long on to get off strike.
That stayed really low! Tossed up delivery outside off, it skids and doesn't rise at all. Sharma goes for the cut but the ball sneaks under his bat and goes into the gloves of the keeper.
Hassan once again darts it on the stumps, whipped away towards mid-wicket for a single.
Darted on the stumps, nudged towards the leg side.
Flatter on the stumps, punched off the back foot to the man at mid off.
Played through mid-wicket by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Tossed up delivery outside off, driven towards long off for one.
Short ball outside off, slapped off the back foot towards cover for a single.
Abhishek Sharma is the new man in.

OUT! Bangladesh have got the big fish! Shubman Gill is walking back. Oh dear, he misses out on a ton which was there for the taking! Maybe, the pressure of the runs being dried out after the wicket of Desai got the better of him. Nayeem is all smiles as he picks up his second. He bowls a flatter delivery, just outside off. Gill crouches low to cut it away but ends up getting a feather to it. Islam Ankon behind the stumps is really sharp to gather it. India in a bit of bother as they lose two set batsmen.
Finally Parag is off the mark! Stays back and works it away through mid-wicket for a single.
Flattish on the stumps, punched back to the bowler who quickly moves to his right to take it.
Flights it up around off, Parag comes down the track and could only bunt it back to the bowler.
Gets to the pitch of the ball and bunts it down to long on for a single.
Good running! A bit short around middle and leg, Gill tucks it in front of square on the leg side for a brace.
Very full on the stumps, Riyan digs it out to the cover fielder.
Comes down the track and Saif spots this. Fires it on the stumps, Riyan mistimes this towards mid-wicket. He took it on the full.
Parag steps out of the track and works it towards the man at short mid-wicket.
Wrists it back to the Bangladesh skipper who stops it in his followthrough.
Around middle and leg, worked around the corner for a single.
Length delivery around middle and leg, punched towards the right of the bowler. Steps out to take the single but the man from short mid-wicket dives to his left to keep him on strike. Good fielding!
Allows the ball to turn back in and punches it back to the bowler. A successful over from Hasan, 2 runs a wicket off it.
Riyan Parag is the new batsman in.

OUT! Harvik Desai drags it on! Another wicket against the run of play and Bangladesh rejoice. They have once again broken the partnership at the right time which was worth 74! Nayeem drops it short and serves it a bit wide outside off, Harvik shapes up for the cut shot but goes too hard at it. Gets a thick inside edge which disturbs the woodwork behind.
Fuller ball on middle, milked down the long on for a single.
Gives it some air, lands it around middle and leg, Shubman gets down to play the sweep shot but gets it off the inner half towards short fine leg.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket.
Tossed up ball on middle and leg, worked with the spin through mid-wicket for one.
Slider around the pads, flicked through square leg for a single.

Almost off the keeper's gloves! Lets the ball come to him does Desai and then at the very last moment he dabs it past the keeper. The ball rolls towards third man as the batsmen hare back for a double.
Flatter one on the stumps, punched back to Saif.
Drops it short and is lucky to get away with that one. Harvik rocks back and punches it through extra cover to collect a couple.
Gets behind the line and keeps it out watchfully.

Tossed up delivery outside off, driven along the ground through cover. There is some confusion in the deep between the fielders. By the time they decide who will go after it, the batsmen take a couple.
Dances down the track again, is done in the flight a bit. Still manages to clip it towards short fine leg.
Comes down the track a touch and flicks it in front of square on the leg side for a brace.
Flighted ball outside off, driven wide of long off for a couple.
The batsman has played it to the point region. They pick up a single.
Gill hits one down to long on for a single.
Length ball around middle and off, pushed off the back foot to mid on.

FOUR! In the gap! Floats it up on the stumps, Desai sees the flight and decides to go after it. Gets down on one knee and slog sweeps it really flat and in the gap towards mid-wicket. Picks up a boundary to end the over in style.
Lunges forward and defends it down.
Spinning back in on middle, helped with a pull behind square on the leg side for a single.
Shortish again, pulled back to the bowler.
The batsman has driven that ball straight back.
Short and turning in, cut away through cover for a single.
Goes back, swivels a bit and pulls it along the ground through mid-wicket. One run added to the total.
Stays back and punches it down the ground towards long on for a single.
Flicks it with the turn through square leg and runs one.
Desai rocks back to this flatter one and pulls it to mid on.
Played to mid-wicket region by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single. Brings up the 50-run stand between the two.
Drops it on the shorter length, hit back to the bowler.

Chance! Floats it up on the stumps, Gill dances down the track and hits it really hard towards cover. The man there dives to his right but the ball falls short of him. He deflects it further and they take a single.
Shimmies down a touch and clips it through square leg for a single. 150 comes up for India!
Switches the angle again, comes from over the wicket and slows it through the air, lands it full outside off. Desai prods forward and pushes it towards the man at short third man off the outer half.
Goes around the wicket and drops it short outside off, crunched through extra cover for one.
Punches this short ball towards the man at mid on.
Beaten! Good ball to start with! An arm ball, Gill presses forward to defend but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Saif Hassan to roll his arm over.
A bit short, slower through the air and it's drifting down leg. Tucked off the back foot towards the man at 45 for nothing.
Eases the full ball down to long on to rotate strike.
Once again leans across and works it straight to the man in the same region
Slows it through the air, lands it full around off, wristed towards the man at short mid-wicket.
Short and flat outside off, slapped a bit square of the wicket on the off side. A single picked up.
Tossed up delivery around middle and leg, Desai nudges it towards the leg side. Wants the run but the keeper is quick to get to the ball to deny them.
Taps it in front of square on the leg side and gets to the other end.
Tad short and served outside off, cut to deep point and will get only a single.
Floats it up around off, defended gently off the front foot as the ball rolls back towards the bowler.
Stays back and wrists it through square leg for a single.
Skids a bit off the deck, hurries the batsman as he manages to punch it back to Afif.
Slider, a bit short on off, pulled towards wide long on for a single.
Punched down to long on and shall retain strike for the next over.
FOUR! Lovely shot! Sees the flight and goes down on one knee does Gill. Gets it around the pads and sweeps it aerially over backward square leg. That nearly carried all the way.
Stays behind the line and blocks it out.

Sits back deep in the crease does Gill and pulls it through mid-wicket again. Call is for two and Desai responds. The throw from the deep comes in at the non-striker's end. Had that hit, things would have been interesting. Harvik isn't the quickest off the blocks.
Another one on the flatter length, punched down towards long on for a single.
Flatter around off, pulled from deep within the crease through mid-wicket for one.
Bowls an arm ball on off, Desai tries to defend but it goes off the outside edge to short third man for no runs.
Very short and wide outside off, cut firmly through point for a couple.
Drags his length back on middle, Gill rocks back and pulls it on the bounce to the fielder at deep mid-wicket for a run.
Flatter outside off, cut through point for a run.
The frustration of not scoring here is getting to Desai. Afif tosses it up on middle, Desai goes for the slog sweep but only gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Shorter in length on off, slaps it to covers.
Afif Hossain back on.
Drags his length back, Gill punches it to mid-wicket. Just a run from the over.
Shorter in length on middle, pulled to square leg.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket.
Excellent fielding from the bowler! Flatter on off, Gill pushes it towards the left of the bowler. He dives full stretch and ensures the batsmen don't get a run.
Works it with the spin to square leg.
Short and wide outside off, cut towards deep point for a run.
Nayeem Hasan is into the attack for the first time today.

Good length on off, Desai guides it towards backward point and they complete one. The point fielder tries to get to it but misfields. Gill wants the second as he is eager to keep strike but Desai refuses.
Slower ball on middle, driven down to long on for a run.
FOUR! Stand and deliver! A Rohit Sharma type shot! A short ball on middle, Gill stands tall and pulls it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Shorter in length outside off, Gill cuts it late, past point. He calls for two immediately and takes two.
Shimmies down the wicket, the bowler bowls it a touch short. Desai pulls it towards wide mid on for a single.
On a length around off, Desai lunges forward and keeps it out.
On the pads again, flicked to deep square leg to keep strike. A steady over, four runs from it.
Works it with the angle through square leg to change strike.
On a length, pushed on the up to covers.
Fullish on middle, Desai drives it towards wide mid on and sets off for a run. The fielder there has a shy at the non-striker's end but misses.
On a length, attacking the stumps, defended towards the bowler.
Full and wide outside off, driven through covers for a run.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.

In the air... but the fielder can't get to it. A short ball on middle, Desai goes for the pull but top edges it over the head of mid on. The fielder there runs back and then puts in a dive but can't get to it. The batsmen take two.
The batsman has driven it through mid off.
Back-to-back 50s for Gill, his 3rd U-19 World Cup half ton. He drives it down to long on for a run to reach that milestone. He raises his bat to the dressing room to acknowledge the applause.
On middle, worked towards mid-wicket.
On the pads, tucked towards square leg for a run.
Robiul Hoque is back into the attack.
On a length around off, guides it down to third man for a run.
Fullish on off, driven to covers.
Excellent delivery! He bowls it on a length around off, it shapes in. Desai chops it to the keeper.
On a length around off, defended solidly.
Shorter in length on middle, tucked to mid-wicket.
Length ball, guided to point.
JUST SHORT! Gill comes down the track and checks his shot back towards the bowler who dives but the ball falls just short of him.
FOUR! What a shot! A little short on middle, Gill rocks back and whips it through mid-wicket for a boundary. He moves onto 49.
Driven towards the mid on region.
Another delivery worked to mid-wicket.
Worked it with the spin to mid-wicket.

A good effort in the field but has the fielder hurt himself? The bowler drags his length back outside off, the batsman punches it through covers. The fielder from deep point runs to his right, dives and stops the ball. He though lands awkwardly and seems to be in some pain. The batsmen in the meanwhile take two.
Fuller on off, driven down to long on for a run.
The batsman works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.
Length outside off, Desai lets it be.
Harvik Desai strides out at no. 4.

OUT! Knocks him over! What a delivery to get rid of the Indian skipper. Completely against the run of play here. Qazi lands it on a length around middle, it is the off cutter. It shapes away after pitching, takes the outside edge and kisses the off pole. Shaw walks back after getting off to a start. A much-needed breakthrough for Bangladesh and they have broken the 86-run stand. Can they now capitalize?
On a length around off, defended to point.
Shorter in length outside off, chopped to point.
Short and wide outside off, cut through point for a run.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads.
Tosses it up on middle, driven back to the bowler.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot. They pick up a single.
Worked it around the corner for a run. 100 up for India.
FOUR! A little too full by the bowler and Shaw makes him pay. He lofts it straight back over the bowler's head for a boundary.
Just ahead on middle, driven down the ground.
Fullish on off, played to covers.
Good batting, follows the boundary with a run. Length outside off, guided down to third man for a run.
FOUR! Up and over! Fuller in length on middle, Shaw lofts it over mid on for India's 12th boundary.
On a length around middle, Shaw on drives it to mid on.
Back of a length on off, pushed to mid off.
Shortish outside off, punched through point for a run.
Gives it air on off, Shaw pushes it to the right of the bowler who dives and saves a run.
Floats it up on middle, worked to square leg for a run.
Shorter outside off, slapped towards extra cover for a single.
Flatter on middle, pushed to covers.
Tosses it up on middle, worked to mid-wicket.
Again on the pads, flicked to mid-wicket.
On a length around off, defended.
Flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Just ahead of a length on off, punched to covers.
Angles it on the pads, clips it to deep square leg for a run.
On a length around off, pushed to covers.
Floats it up on middle, driven back to the bowler.
Very full on off, jams it down to long on for a single.
Comes down the track and flicks it off the inner half through square leg for a brace.
Works it around the corner for a run.
Flatter on off, pushed down to long off for a run.

Catch it is the call... but lands well short of the fielder. Shaw comes down the track but does not get to the pitch of it. He still goes ahead with the shot and it lands well short of the long on fielder for a run.
Another length delivery outside off, Shaw plays it with an angled bat down towards third man to keep strike.
Length ball around off, guided down to third man for a run.
Back of a length on middle, played to mid off.
OUCH! The bowler is down in pain! It is never a good idea to try and stop the ball with your feet and Qazi tries to do exactly that and now is hurt. The physio has come out to have a look.
THAT MUST HAVE STUNG! Fuller on middle, driven towards the bowler. He tries to stop it with his leg, he is successful in doing so but has hurt himself in the process.

India are off to a good start. They lost Kalra early but these two have done reasonably well to steady the ship. They are going at 6.6 runs per over. Bangladesh need to stop this and get a breakthrough soon...
On a length around off, guided towards third man for a couple.
Angles it on the pads, worked to mid-wicket.
Quicker on middle, Prithvi defends it towards mid-wicket.
Floats it up on off, defended towards cover to change strike.
Works it with the turn towards square leg for a run.
Flatter outside off, guided to short third man for a run.
Tosses it up on middle, Gill defends it.
Short outside off, Shaw pushes it down to long on for a run.
Powerplay 2 has been signaled. 4 fielders can be placed outside the circle now. Also spin for the first time today. Afif Hossain is into the attack.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries! He is dealing in it. Full and wide outside off, Gill leans into it and drives it through covers to move to 30. 10 runs from this over.

FOUR! Gill has come out all guns blazing here. He has also been helped by some poor bowling but you have to make the most of it. He once again gets a delivery on the pads which he flicks fine down the leg side. This also brings the 50-run stand up.
Works it around the corner with the angle for a run.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman.

Back of a length on middle, Gill tries to pull but the length is not short enough. He is beaten as the ball hits him on the thigh pad. There is an ambitious appeal by the bowler but the umpire shakes his head. The batsmen take a leg bye in the meantime.
Back of a length on off, Gill is solid in defense.
Shortish outside off, not a lot of width on offer. Shaw tries to cut it but it goes off the bottom edge to point.
Full on the pads, flicked through square leg for a run.
FOUR! Exquisite! Full and on middle, Gill drives it with a straight bat down the ground and there is no stopping that.
On a length around middle, pushed to mid on.
Length on off, defended off the front foot.
Fuller on middle, it also swings in a touch. Gill tries to drive but it goes off the inner half through square leg for a couple.
Another length ball around off, plays it towards point. Shaw wants a run but it wasn't on. End of a wayward over by the bowler.
On the pads, flicked straight to short fine leg. Another scoring opportunity goes abegging.
Changes his angle and bowls a better line. Outside off and the batsman defends it to point.
Another ball down the leg side, the keeper does really well to stop that. The umpire signals a wide.
Full and wide outside off, Shaw tries to drive but gets beaten. He would feel he missed out on another scoring opportunity there.
FOUR! 50 up for India, they are off to a flier here. What a lovely way to bring it up. On the pads, Shaw maintains his balance beautifully and flicks it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Down the leg side, Shaw misses the flick. The umpire signals a wide.
Right on the money first up! Back of a length on the stumps, Shaw blocks it.
Qazi Onik is into the attack.
Very full on middle, driven towards cover. The fielder there makes a half stop and concedes a run.
FOUR! Makes full use of the Free Hit! Full on the stumps, Shaw hits it where there is never a fielder placed, right over the bowler's head for a boundary.
NO BALL! Another delivery on the pads, Shaw flicks it through backward square leg for a couple. A Free Hit for Shaw.
Shorter in length on off, Shaw plays it late under his eyes and onto the ground.
FOUR! Short ball outside off, Shaw is onto it in a flash. He rocks back and cuts it with all his might through point for a boundary. This should get the Indian skipper going.
Angles it in on middle on a shorter length. Shaw tucks it to mid-wicket.
Fullish on off, driven to covers.

FOUR! Poor bowling with the fine leg up in the ring. He bowls it on the pads, Gill once again flicks it very fine down the leg side and the ball races away. So after a few quiet overs at the start, runs have now started to flow.
Back of a length on off, pushed to mid on.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Another appeal! Gill walks across his stump and misses the flick to the ball on his pads. It his his front pad and the Bangladesh players appeal but the umpire is not interested. A leg bye taken.
Bowls it down the leg side and once again the umpire has to do some stretching.
Even on his defensive strokes it looks like he wants to score. Hoque bowls it fuller on off, Hoque pushes it firmly back towards the bowler.
FOUR! Full and on the stumps, Gill is in too good a form to miss out on those. He flicks it through mid-wicket and the ball races away.
Short outside off, surprises the batsman. He pulls it awkwardly over mid on and some good running helps the batsmen take three.

The way he hit that shows the confidence he is playing with. Gill did not get runs for it but it would surely boost his confidence. A ball just ahead of a length around off, Gill punches it crisply on the up to mid off.
Full and outside off, Gill does not fiddle with it.
A slip comes in now.
Short ball outside off, Shaw can't resist himself and goes for the cut shot. He gets an outside edge which flies down towards third man but only for a run as there is a man there.
Another delivery on a length, angling into the batsman, cramping him for room. Shaw defends it.
WIDE! Short and outside off, once again it bounces above the batsman's head and the umpire signals a wide.
This is really good bowling by Bangladesh! The bowler lands it on a length around off, Shaw can't do a lot on that delivery as he has to defend it to covers.
Back of a length on middle, Gill defends it.

FOUR! Off the mark in style! Sloppy effort in the field! Hoque errs in line and bowls it on the pads, Gill flicks it fine down the leg side. The fielder there runs to his right but puts in a lazy effort and lets the ball through.
Fullish on middle, driven back to the bowler.
Shubman Gill walks out to the middle.

OUT! Hoque strikes! An excellent catch by Hridoy! A short ball around off, Manjot rocks back and punches it towards cover-point. He fails to keep it down though. Hridoy in that region dives forward and takes it inches above the ground. An early wicket, just the start Bangladesh wanted and they are pumped up. Also, this is the first time India have lost a wicket in the Powerplay in this tournament.

FOUR! Edgy but Manjot will accept it with open arms! First boundary for India. Full and wide outside off, Manjot goes after it with minimal foot movement. He flashed hard there and gets an outside edge over the leaping first slip fielder for a boundary.
Attacking the stumps and pitches it on a length. Manjot defends it towards point.
Back of a length around off, taps it towards point for a quick run. This is good by the Indian batsmen. The boundaries are not easy to come by so they are looking out for singles.
Another length delivery on the stumps, Manjot defends it off the back foot. Good lines here by the Bangladesh bowlers.
Back of a length, angling into the batsman. Flicked to mid-wicket.
Excellent effort in the field! Fuller on off, it is nicely timed through covers. The fielder from that position hares after it, dives and saves two for his side.
Just behind a length on middle, Majot guides it to point.
Shorter in length outside off, Manjot fails to cash in on the width offered as he gets beaten.
Fuller in length around middle, shaping away. Shaw gets a soft leading edge towards mid off. Not a confident start for the Indian captain.

A huge appeal but not given! Sliding down leg! Hoque goes wide of the crease and angles it into the pads. Shaw misses the flick and is hit on the pads. The players appeal but the umpire shakes his head.
Fuller on middle, driven crisply to mid on.
Good length on off, Shaw defends it stoutly.
The bowler goes short again on off, Shaw rocks back and punches it through cover-point. He does not time it well enough to take it all the way but times it well enough to get two.
Good length! That is what the Bangladesh bowlers should be bowling. On a length around off, shapes into the batsman. Prithvi defends it.
Starts as Mahmud did, with a wide. Hoque bowls it short and wide outside off, Shaw lets it be and the umpire signals a wide.
Robiul Hoque will bowl from the other end.

Fullish on middle, Manjot drives it back firmly towards the bowler. He tries to stop it with his feet but only manages to deflect it through wide mid on and the batsmen take two. A good start for India.
Just behind a length on off, punched to mid off. That came right off the middle but straight to the fielder.
Good bowling! Full and wide outside off, tempting the the batsman to drive. He does go after it but gets beaten.
Errs in line and bowls it on the pads, Manjot misses the flick and the ball brushes the pads and goes down towards fine leg. The keeper gives it a chase and keeps it down to two leg byes.
Another short ball outside off. This time it bounces a touch more. Shaw guides it down to third man for a single. He gets off the mark.
Shorter in length outside off, width on offer. Prithvi needs no sighters, he straightaway goes after it but is beaten by the low bounce.

Starts off with a short ball, a good move by the bowler as the batsman won't be expecting it. It though, bounces above the batsman's head and the umpire stretches his hands. India are underway courtesy an extra.

After the completion of the national anthems we are set to get underway. The Bangladesh players make their way out to the middle. Prithvi Shaw and Manjot Kalra will open the batting for India. Hasan Mahmud will open the bowling. Here we go..

Bangladesh skipper, Saif Hassan, says they wanted to bowl first. Further adds the wicket looks good to bat on but they would prefer chasing. States it is probably the biggest game of their career. Informs Robiul Hoque comes in for Tipu Sultan.

Indian skipper, Prithvi Shaw, says they are going to bat. Mentions it looks like a good wicket. Admits the preparations have been good heading into this game. Informs Arshdeep Singh goes out and Ishan Porel comes in.
TOSS - India win the toss and opt to bat!

Hello and welcome to the quarterfinal of the U-19 World Cup in Queenstown. It is a clash between the tournament favourites, India and Bangladesh. The Men in Blue are unbeaten so far and come into this game with their morale really high. The Bangla Tigers, on the other hand, are underdogs heading into this game. They will look to spring a surprise but they will to have to play out of their skins if they are to beat a very strong-looking Indian side. Who will face Pakistan in the semifinal? We will have to wait to find out. Stay tuned for the toss.
